The '''Argai Players''' performed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argai]]. Annually, they performed the trilogies of [[Lisst'n]] dramatist [[Lyechusas]] on [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]]. The performances were sold out every year.
